title: Local LLM vs Cloud: Route Easy Tasks to Save Money
description:
Stop paying cloud prices for easy tasks. ⚡

✅ Point easy tasks at your local Ollama endpoint
✅ Send hard ones to the cloud endpoint
✅ Run a tiny Python router to see each route

Day 8 of Local AI Coding. Next up: Day 9, Give a Local Model Tools via MCP.
Follow for a new short every day and build your local AI setup.

#shorts #ollama #localai #aitools #coding #aicoding #python
comment: Local or cloud: which gets your next task? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: start simple, keep renames and small edits local, and only send design-level work to the cloud endpoint.
